script_text: Saturn squares your fiery natal Sun this week, Sagittarius — expect a sudden reality check that completely reshapes your priorities. Early in the week, Mercury in Leo forms a trine to your natal Jupiter in Gemini, giving you sharp communication energy Monday through Wednesday, though Tuesday carries a Mars-Saturn tension that delays important decisions. By Wednesday, Venus enters Leo and slips into your 5th House, igniting romantic creativity and a magnetic pull toward someone unexpected. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun opposes Neptune in Aries, blurring your career boundaries — be cautious with financial commitments late in the week. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, awakening passion and creative confidence. Friday is your worst day because Mercury squares Uranus, causing miscommunications and impulsive choices. Trust your instincts but verify every detail before signing anything this week.
